title: Audit of the San Jacinto Club's books and the missing money
summary: As an audit committee member he finds the treasurer borrowed against the club and the books short $2,200; secretary Monette gambled collected money away on a card game.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs
